description: Everything public about one land parcel (działka) in Poland: parcel id, area and land-use class from the land register (EGiB), local zoning plan (MPZP) and zoning symbol, utility networks on or near the plot (water, sewer, gas, power, heat, telecom – GESUT), flood hazard (ISOK maps), nature protection areas (GDOŚ) and plot prices nearby (RCN). query: parcel id "302109_4.0001.100", "obręb number" like "Bnin 100" or "obręb Bnin działka 100 gmina Kórnik", an address "Kórnik, Poznańska 1" (the parcel under the address point) or "lat,lon".

commune.description: Gmina / powiat name to pick the right parcel when 'obręb number' matches several
